development.name: Tidal Salvage Diver
development.brief: Heavy diving visor, mounted cylinder with hose, protected torso and open salvage hook. Retain grounded boots and maintenance case.

holdout.name: Saltmarsh Rescue Technician
holdout.brief: Marsh rescue technician with protective cuff closer to the body, a short rescue hook and a dedicated flotation pouch. Keep the same protection family and use a compact braced pose.
capabilityGaps: A and B lack a dedicated flotation pouch. The shared maintenance case remains as a proxy.
A and B reuse a full-size hook. The compact hook silhouette required by the brief remains unsupported.
B reuses the sealed gloves and cuff as-is. The closer placement comes from the rig, with no rescue-specific cuff.
A has oilskin and an A-line garment. It cannot represent a sealed diving visor, air tank or protective suit harness.
The paired track fixes exactly the same procedural hook and equipment. Only the forehand glove shape and paint differ.
The full Hybrid panel includes helmet, protected torso and a differently shaped open hook. Judge its brief coverage separately.
